title: Best Employee Onboarding Automation Tools for IT (2027)
summary: Compare the best employee onboarding automation tools for IT in 2027, including features for account setup, access management, and workflows.
body_markdown:
IT teams need to ensure new hires have working devices, configured accounts, software access, and security credentials before their first day. However, manual coordination between HR, IT, and hiring managers can delay these tasks, leaving employees without the tools they need to get started.


Employee onboarding automation helps teams streamline account provisioning, software access, approvals, and other repetitive tasks. By connecting systems and standardizing workflows, organizations can reduce manual handoffs, improve coordination, and provide a smoother onboarding experience.


For IT teams managing employee requests throughout onboarding,[Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) complements dedicated provisioning tools with[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) ,[purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) , and[workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) . These capabilities help IT and HR teams answer common questions, route requests, manage approvals, and coordinate tasks across connected systems.


## **Key Takeaways**


- IT onboarding automation tools fall into several categories, including internal support platforms, enterprise IT service management (ITSM), all-in-one HR and IT platforms, and endpoint management solutions.
- Zero-touch device provisioning allows IT teams to configure devices remotely and ship them directly to employees, reducing manual setup and improving onboarding efficiency.
- IT teams should evaluate tools based on HRIS integration depth, mobile device management (MDM), single sign-on (SSO), workflow automation, and security and compliance capabilities.
- Enterprise ITSM platforms can support employee onboarding through service catalogs, automated ticket routing, approval workflows, and audit trails that help teams coordinate requests across departments.
- [Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) provides[Slack-native internal support](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) with[purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) ,[workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , and self-learning knowledge bases for IT, HR, Finance, and other departments managing employee onboarding and ongoing support requests.
- Implementation timelines depend on platform complexity, integration requirements, existing infrastructure, and the amount of internal configuration required.


## **What IT Teams Should Look for in Onboarding Automation Tools**


IT onboarding has different requirements from HR paperwork automation. While HR teams focus on offer letters, tax forms, and policy acknowledgements, IT teams need to provision devices, create accounts, configure software access, and enforce security policies.


A strong IT onboarding automation tool should help teams:


- Trigger device and app provisioning automatically when HR adds a new hire to the HRIS
- Manage identity and access across cloud and on-premises applications
- Support zero-touch device enrollment without manual IT intervention
- Automate account creation, SSO configuration, and MFA enrollment
- Connect with existing MDM, SSO, and ITSM systems


The most practical systems eliminate manual handoffs between HR and IT while giving IT teams control over provisioning workflows. When combined with an internal support platform that can handle the inevitable new hire questions, IT teams can deliver a seamless onboarding experience.

## **2) ServiceNow**


ServiceNow provides enterprise ITSM capabilities that support onboarding workflows through service catalogs, automated routing, and audit trails.


### **Primary Focus**


ServiceNow automates routing, assignment, and approval processes across SaaS, hardware, on-premises software, and services. Organizations with existing ServiceNow deployments can extend those capabilities to onboarding.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Automated employee onboarding workflows with ITSM integration
- Service catalog for provisioning requests and approvals
- Comprehensive audit trails and compliance tracking
- Routing and assignment across multiple service types


## **3) Freshservice**


Freshservice provides cloud-based IT service management with onboarding automation capabilities for organizations managing internal service requests.


### **Primary Focus**


Freshservice offers ITIL-aligned service desk functionality with employee onboarding workflows, asset management, and IT operations management in a cloud-first platform.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Onboarding workflow automation with service catalog
- Asset lifecycle management and device tracking
- Self-service portal and knowledge base
- Approvals and routing across departments


## **4) Jira Service Management**


Jira Service Management treats onboarding as a service request with defined SLAs, automation rules, and integration across the Atlassian ecosystem.


### **Primary Focus**


Teams already using ITIL-aligned service management can use Jira Service Management to structure onboarding workflows.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Service catalog-based onboarding requests with SLA-driven routing
- ITIL-aligned service management workflows
- Automation rules for service workflows
- Useful handoff paths between IT, HR, and operations teams


## **5) Rippling**


Rippling combines HR and IT data in a shared system, helping reduce synchronization issues between separate HR and IT tools.


### **Primary Focus**


Rippling automates device provisioning and software access as part of the same workflow that handles offer letters and tax forms. When HR adds a new hire, the system can automatically order devices, create accounts, and configure software access.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Automated device shipping and app provisioning tied to hiring events
- Single employee record shared across HR, IT, and finance
- Automatic corporate card issuance with role-based spending limits
- MDM and SSO capabilities built into the platform


## **6) Okta**


Okta automates user provisioning across thousands of cloud and on-premises applications, making it a foundation for identity-driven onboarding automation.


### **Primary Focus**


Okta provides the identity layer that connects HRIS systems to application provisioning. When a new hire is added to the HRIS, Okta can automatically create accounts and configure SSO across all connected applications.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Universal Directory with lifecycle management for hire-to-retire workflows
- Automated user provisioning across thousands of pre-built app integrations
- Single sign-on and adaptive multi-factor authentication
- Integration with major HRIS platforms including Workday and BambooHR


## **7) Microsoft Intune and Autopilot**


Microsoft Intune with Windows Autopilot provides zero-touch device provisioning for organizations in Microsoft-centric environments.


### **Primary Focus**


For organizations standardized on Microsoft 365, Intune and Autopilot provide native device management and zero-touch provisioning that allows devices to ship directly from OEMs to pre-configured employees.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Zero-touch Windows device provisioning via Autopilot
- MDM policies and configurations applied automatically
- Devices can ship directly from OEM to employee pre-configured
- Included with many Microsoft 365 Enterprise plans


## **8) BetterCloud**


BetterCloud is a SaaS management platform that automates user provisioning, application access, and operational workflows across the SaaS stack.


### **Primary Focus**


BetterCloud focuses on automating the SaaS layer of IT onboarding, helping teams provision users across cloud applications without manual configuration.


### **Key Capabilities**


- No-code workflow builder for SaaS onboarding automation
- Automated onboarding process templates for fast customization
- Built-in logic for SaaS apps requiring fewer workflow steps
- SaaS management for users, applications, and software spending


## **9) Workday**


Workday provides a full HCM suite including HR, payroll, and ERP capabilities for large organizations operating across multiple countries, currencies, and business units.


### **Primary Focus**


Workday serves as the HRIS foundation for enterprise IT provisioning workflows. Its Onboarding Journeys feature provides personalized step-by-step paths that can trigger IT provisioning through connected systems.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Onboarding Journeys with personalized step-by-step paths
- Native learning management system integration
- Global workforce support with multi-entity capabilities
- AI features for streamlining HR tasks


## **10) Unduit**


Unduit focuses on IT-led provisioning, combining onboarding automation with ITSM and MDM integrations.


### **Primary Focus**


Unduit emphasizes the IT side of onboarding rather than HR paperwork. It supports the full asset lifecycle from procurement to disposal, covering global organizations with distributed workforces.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Native MDM, SSO, and ITSM integrations
- AI automation across the platform for provisioning workflows
- Full asset lifecycle support including procurement, deployment, and disposal
- Removes manual handoffs between HR, IT, and hiring managers

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the primary benefit of using automation tools for IT employee onboarding?**


Automation tools reduce manual handoffs between HR, IT, and hiring managers by streamlining tasks such as account creation, device provisioning, and software access. When connected to an HRIS, these workflows can trigger automatically when a new hire is added, helping IT teams reduce delays and maintain consistent onboarding processes. Platforms like Unthread complement provisioning tools by[automating the internal support](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) requests and approvals that accompany onboarding.


### **How do self-learning knowledge bases improve IT onboarding?**


Self-learning knowledge bases identify recurring questions from resolved support tickets and generate draft articles for review. For example, when employees repeatedly ask about VPN setup or software access, IT teams can use these articles to build reusable onboarding documentation.[Unthread's knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) helps identify repeated questions and documentation gaps, reducing repetitive requests over time.


### **Can onboarding tools integrate with existing HR and IT systems like HRIS or Jira?**


Yes. Onboarding platforms can connect with HRIS systems, identity providers, and ITSM tools to coordinate employee information, account provisioning, and support workflows. Unthread integrates with business applications and ITSM platforms to[trigger workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , route employee requests, and coordinate actions across connected systems. Its Enterprise capabilities also include HRIS integration and employee directory synchronization.


### **How does a Slack-native helpdesk improve IT onboarding efficiency?**


A Slack-native helpdesk lets employees submit requests and receive assistance without switching to a separate ticketing portal. With[Unthread](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) , purpose-built AI agents can reference approved knowledge base content to answer routine questions about VPN setup, software access, and internal policies. More complex requests can be routed to the appropriate IT staff, while[workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) help manage recurring tasks and approvals. This allows IT teams to spend less time handling repetitive questions and more time addressing complex onboarding needs.
